newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures slip in technical correction.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures slip in technical correction.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower across the board on Tuesday, continuing a technical correction of a rally late last year, traders said.
The yen's rebound against the dollar also encouraged local investors to take profits, they said.
Rubber prices ended 1.6 yen to 2.1 yen per kg lower. Benchmark June was 1.9 yen weaker at 146.8 yen per kg.

"After the rapid rises at the end of last year, a technical correction is likely to continue for a few more days. Benchmark June could test 145 yen," one analyst at a commodity broker said. --Tokyo Commodity Desk, +81-3-3432-7431
